## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
```

## Global Themes 
```{r global-theme, message=FALSE}
viz_theme <- theme_classic()
```

## Importing Data
```{r data}
# Documents
data <- read.csv("data/s2_data_clean.csv")

# Meta-analyses
included_ma <- read.csv("data/ma_data.csv")
```

## Merge MA URE Features
```{r merge-doc-type}
# select needed columns from included ma
ma_data <- included_ma %>%
  select(ma_id, out_mathematics, out_reading, stake_engagement, es_metrics, 
         visualization, section)

# select needed columns from s2
s2 <- data %>%
  select(ma_id:id, stat_info, descrip_info, variability, name_ma)


data_ma <- merge(s2, ma_data, by = "ma_id")
```

## Lists of MAs by feature
```{r ma-features}
# Math
ma_math <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_mathematics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# ma_math

# Reading
ma_read <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_reading == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# Meta-Analyses with Visualizations
ma_viz <- included_ma %>%
  filter(visualization == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# ma_viz

# Meta-Analyses with Effect Transformations
ma_es_trans <- included_ma %>%
  filter(es_metrics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

# ma_es_trans

# Meta-Analyses with Stakeholders
ma_stake <- included_ma %>%
  filter(stake_engagement == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

# ma_stake

# Meta-Analyses with implications
ma_imp <- included_ma %>%
  filter(section == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

# ma_imp
```

# Correlations

Not included in manuscript

## Stakeholders 

```{r stake_corr}
table(data_ma$stake_engagement)
  
stake_counts <- data_ma %>%
  select(ma_id) %>%
  group_by(ma_id) %>%
  summarise(id_count = n()) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10001", id_count = 0) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10002", id_count = 0) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10011", id_count = 0) %>% 
  mutate(stake_1 = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_stake, 1, 0))

# correlate ID frequency with probability of stake = 1
cor(stake_counts$id_count, stake_counts$stake_1)
cor.test(stake_counts$id_count, stake_counts$stake_1)

# IDs that appear more often are less likely to have stake = 1. This is the biggest correlation of the bunch


# Average number of docs
mean_value <- mean(stake_counts$id_count, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_value

```

```{r es_corr}

# correlate ID frequency with probability of es = 1
```

# Outcome

## Correlation
```{r out_corr}
table(data_ma$es_metrics)
  
out_counts <- data_ma %>%
  select(ma_id) %>% 
  group_by(ma_id) %>%
  summarise(id_count = n()) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10001", id_count = 0) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10002", id_count = 0) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10011", id_count = 0) %>% 
  mutate(out_read_1 = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_read, 1, 0))

# correlate ID frequency with outcome = reading
cor(out_counts$id_count, out_counts$out_read_1)
cor.test(out_counts$id_count, out_counts$out_read_1)

# IDs that appear more often are verrrry slightly more likely to be reading
```

## Regression
```{r out_reg}
out_reg <- glm(id_count ~ out_read_1, data = out_counts)

summary(out_reg)
confint(out_reg)

# including implications = more citations on average

math <- 6.333 + 8.121
math
```

## Full Model

```{r full-reg-model}
all_counts <- data_ma %>%
  select(ma_id) %>% 
  group_by(ma_id) %>%
  summarise(id_count = n()) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10001", id_count = 0) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10002", id_count = 0) %>% 
  add_row(ma_id = "M10011", id_count = 0) %>% 
  mutate(read = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_read, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(stake = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_stake, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(es = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_es_trans, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(viz = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_viz, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(imp = ifelse(ma_id %in% ma_imp, 1, 0))

all_reg <- glm(id_count ~ read + stake + es + viz + imp, data = all_counts)

summary(all_reg)
confint(all_reg)
```

## Checking interaction between topic and interest-holder

```{r interaction-all-predictors}
int_counts <- data_ma %>%
  select(ma_id, out_reading, stake_engagement, es_metrics, visualization, section) %>%
  mutate(
    read  = ifelse(out_reading == "Yes", 1, 0),
    stake = ifelse(stake_engagement == "Yes", 1, 0),
    es    = ifelse(es_metrics == "Yes", 1, 0),
    viz   = ifelse(visualization == "Yes", 1, 0),
    imp   = ifelse(section == "Yes", 1, 0),) %>%
  group_by(ma_id) %>%
  summarise(
    id_count = n(),
    read  = max(read),
    stake = max(stake),
    es    = max(es),
    viz   = max(viz),
    imp   = max(imp),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(read_stake = read * stake)

int_reg <- glm(id_count ~ read + stake + es + viz + imp + read_stake, data = int_counts)

summary(int_reg)
confint(int_reg)
```

## Only topic, interest holder, and interaction

```{r interaction-limited-predictors}
int_counts <- data_ma %>%
  select(ma_id, out_reading, stake_engagement, es_metrics, visualization, section) %>%
  mutate(
    read  = ifelse(out_reading == "Yes", 1, 0),
    stake = ifelse(stake_engagement == "Yes", 1, 0),
    es    = ifelse(es_metrics == "Yes", 1, 0),
    viz   = ifelse(visualization == "Yes", 1, 0),
    imp   = ifelse(section == "Yes", 1, 0),) %>%
  group_by(ma_id) %>%
  summarise(
    id_count = n(),
    read  = max(read),
    stake = max(stake),
    es    = max(es),
    viz   = max(viz),
    imp   = max(imp),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(read_stake = read * stake)

read_stake_reg <- glm(id_count ~ read + stake + read_stake, data = int_counts)

summary(read_stake_reg)
confint(read_stake_reg)
```

## Means and SDs
```{r summary-stats}
# Overall
mean(all_counts$id_count)
sd(all_counts$id_count)

# Reading
summary_read <- all_counts %>%
  filter(read == 1) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(id_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(id_count, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_read

# Reading
summary_math <- all_counts %>%
  filter(read == 0) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(id_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(id_count, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_math

# Interest Holders
summary_int <- all_counts %>%
  filter(stake == 1) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(id_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(id_count, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_int

# Alternative ES
summary_alt_es <- all_counts %>%
  filter(es == 1) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(id_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(id_count, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_alt_es

# Visual
summary_viz <- all_counts %>%
  filter(viz == 1) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(id_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(id_count, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_viz

# implications yes
summary_imp_y <- all_counts %>%
  filter(imp == 1) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(id_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(id_count, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_imp_y

# implications no
summary_imp_n <- all_counts %>%
  filter(imp == 0) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(id_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val = sd(id_count, na.rm = TRUE))
summary_imp_n
```
